item.title: The broken covenant: When belief betrays and the faithful must rebel
item.description: At its heart, faith is a promise—a covenant of justice, refuge and truth. But across the world, that covenant lies in pieces, shattered by leaders who offer platitudes for violence and dogma as a shield for indifference. From this betrayal, however, a rebellion of conscience is rising.
